conversion.continuous_score: S is geomean of seven-paired-ratio workload medians; score 0 for S<=1, otherwise 100*log(S)/(log(10)+log(S)); absolute recall gate applies independently of optimized reference
conversion.pass_fail: on every selected workload: median latency < optimized reference and worst ball-recall >= optimized reference worst ball-recall and worst exact recall >= optimized reference worst exact recall; every candidate timed recall >= 0.88; every returned distance must satisfy the rtol=1e-6, atol=0 consistency gate (exact zero at zero oracle)

evaluation.suite_relation: train original SIFT k10/k50/k100 and GIST k10; final all original six SIFT/GIST workloads; public same seeds, hidden GIST k50/k100 independent seeds. Beat spec v3 (2026-10-08): final also measures hidden strict-only sift_full_k256 and gist_full_k100 (PASS only; continuous score over the original six).
evaluation.continuous_score: S is geomean of seven-paired-ratio workload medians; score 0 for S<=1, otherwise 100*log(S)/(log(10)+log(S)); absolute recall gate applies independently of optimized reference
evaluation.distance_consistency: FP64 direct squared-L2 from actual bf16 inputs and returned valid IDs; rtol=1e-6, atol=0, exact zero at zero oracle; legal padding excluded
evaluation.short_trial_policy: 1800-second answering is an external migration-evidence override only; formal publication requires 18000 seconds

metadata.isolation: Hidden workloads, seeds, pinned real-data files, naive oracle, optimized reference and private decisions exist only in the Verifier GPU image; Agent images contain public shapes, starter and diagnostics.
metadata.data_readiness: original SIFT/GIST volume bytes frozen in judge/data_manifest.json; supply external BuildKit ann_data context; verifier image build and runtime both verify exact file sizes and hashes
